title: Umami Creamy Italian Mushroom Lasagna
description: A rich and indulgent Italian dish featuring melted butter, soffritto-base, and creamy mushroom sauce, all layered in a Jain-friendly lasagna form
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside
In a large skillet, saute the chopped onion, carrot, and celery in melted butter until softened
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown
Stir in the tomato puree and nutritional yeast, and bring the mixture to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer while you assemble the lasagna
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lasagna noodles, mushroom sauce, and any additional melted butter needed to coat the noodles

In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the mushroom sauce on the bottom, followed by a layer of noodles, and then a layer of the sauce, repeating this process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of sauce on top
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top layer is lightly browned
